subject.title: fix(cli): align gateway agent timeout default

question: Should omitted `openclaw agent --timeout` calls stop applying the shipped client-side ten-minute timeout and instead inherit gateway timeout policy?
rationale: The implementation follows the existing optional-field and owner-boundary contracts, but it intentionally changes effective behavior for existing users and therefore requires maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Adopt gateway ownership
options.body: Require exact-head live proof, then merge the server-owned omission design and document that users wanting a shorter cap must configure one explicitly.

options.title: Retain the client cap
options.body: Keep the shipped runtime fallback and limit this PR to removing misleading generic documentation examples.

recommendation.title: Adopt gateway ownership
recommendation.body: Require exact-head live proof, then merge the server-owned omission design and document that users wanting a shorter cap must configure one explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the centralized timeout policy and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding its CLI compatibility behavior.
